selection_policy: papers most relevant to publicly described current work in locality, fine-tuning, quantum foundations, the measurement problem, superdeterminism, testability, and quantum-gravity-linked collapse

publications.title: How Gravity Can Explain the Collapse of the Wavefunction
publications.summary: Presents a phenomenological argument that a fundamental matter-geometry theory can produce an effective local, parameter-free collapse model with testable predictions.

publications.title: Taxonomy for Physics Beyond Quantum Mechanics
publications.journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society A 480, 20230779 (2024)
publications.summary: Defines a structured vocabulary for models beyond standard quantum mechanics and clarifies distinctions among superdeterministic, retrocausal, future-input-dependent, atemporal, and related approaches.

publications.title: Quantum Confusions, Cleared Up (or so I hope)
publications.summary: Uses an instrumental approach and the newer taxonomy to examine common claims about quantum interpretations, especially claims involving locality.

publications.title: Bell's theorem allows local theories of quantum mechanics
publications.summary: Emphasizes that Bell-type conclusions depend on statistical-independence assumptions and that locally causal completions remain possible if those assumptions are relaxed.

publications.title: What does it take to solve the measurement problem?
publications.summary: Separates different aspects of the measurement problem and states properties a theory would need in order to count as a solution rather than merely an interpretation.

publications.title: Comment on "Experimentally adjudicating between different causal accounts of Bell-inequality violations via statistical model selection"
publications.summary: Argues that broad superdeterministic model classes are not adequately assessed by restricted statistical-model examples and treats overfitting as the operationally relevant notion of fine-tuning.

publications.title: A Future-Input Dependent Path Integral for Quantum Mechanics
publications.summary: Constructs a path integral over Hilbert space that reproduces quantum mechanics and provides a framework that can be modified to include wavefunction collapse.

publications.title: A Toy Model for Local and Deterministic Wave-function Collapse
publications.summary: Provides a concrete local deterministic toy model that reproduces quantum predictions after averaging hidden variables while violating statistical independence.
